fichas.title: Lightning protection zones and equipotential bonding
fichas.summary: Explains lightning protection zones from 0A and 0B outside the building to zones 1 and higher inside. Describes equipotential bonding and protection of incoming electrical, IT, telephone, water, gas, and other services. Higher-numbered zones can provide additional protection for sensitive rooms and equipment.
uses: Categorize areas by exposure to direct lightning strikes and lightning discharge fields
Bond incoming services to the lightning protection system
Provide additional protection for electronic equipment
figure_refs: 1 Principle of lightning protection equipotential bonding
6 Categorisation of a building into lightning protection zones

fichas.title: Lightning protection design methods and classes
fichas.summary: Presents lightning protection design using the lightning sphere, protection angle, and mesh process. A graph relates protection angle to height and protection class. The accompanying table lists protection-class effectiveness, lightning-sphere radius, mesh width, typical down-conductor spacing, and peak lightning current.
uses: Design lightning protection coverage using a lightning sphere, protection angle, or mesh process
Select lightning protection class and associated system parameters

Lightning protection zones

The property to be protected is categorised into various lightning
protection zones (LPZ) ---> 0.
Protection zone OA:

This is outside a building to be protected. Direct lightning strikes
are possible in this area, and there is an undamped field of
lightning discharge.
Protection zone OB:

The lightning protection equipment on the building to be protected
results in areas in which direct lightning strikes can be ruled out
according to the protection class. There is an undamped field of
lightning discharge. Such areas outside the building are described
as protection zone OB.
Protection zone 1:

Drainage pipe

Foundation earthing electrode

This describes the actual building to be protected The boundary
of protection zone 0 is normally the roof, the external walls and
the cellar floor of the building to be protected, of which the
characteristics (shielding of the external envelope of the building)
have to fulfil certain requirements.
Protection zone 2 and higher:

0 Principle of lightning protection equipotential bonding
80

It can be sensible, or requested, to provide further protection
zones inside protection zone 1. For example, the central server
room as protection zone 2 and individual electronic devices as
protection zone 3.
